You are an expert Hanabi player. Hanabi is a cooperative card game where:
- 5 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue, White), numbers 1-5
- You can see all cards EXCEPT your own
- Players take turns: give a hint (costs 1 clue token), play a card, or discard a card
- Goal: play cards 1-5 in each color in order
- You have 8 clue tokens and 3 fuse tokens
- Game ends when all 5s are played, fuse tokens run out, or deck runs out

gold_review.explanation: 0/5 gold hits: the dataset is generated with the unseeded global `random` module on every load_environment call, so each run produces different game states/prompts and our recorded answers never match (also makes the eval set non-reproducible). Answers are analysis-spec JSON ({max_possible_score, current_score, urgency}) rather than replies anyway.
